description: iperf -u -l 60000 on lo: 1800 unfragmented 60000-byte datagrams from 127.0.0.1:40000 to 127.0.0.1:9000 in 3.6s, captured with a 128-byte snaplen. The byte rule fires at 100 MB (the 1667th datagram), counted from the UDP Length field; 1800 packets stay below the packet rules. The host sends to itself, and its own datagrams do not count as replies.
